name: Business Green Rewards Card from American Express

localized_names.en: Business Green Rewards Card from American Express

apr.notes: 17.74%–28.49% variable APR applies to balances placed on Pay Over Time (as of 2026).

fx_fee.notes: 2.7% foreign transaction fee (standard American Express rate).

base_rate.description: 1X points on other eligible purchases made using your Business Green Rewards Card.

rewards.redemption_notes: Membership Rewards points can be used for travel, gift cards, statement credits, and more.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 15,000 Membership Rewards points after spending $3,000 on eligible purchases within the first 3 months of Card Membership.

benefits.title: Pay Over Time Feature
benefits.description: The Pay Over Time feature lets you carry a balance with interest on eligible charges, up to your Pay Over Time Limit. Eligible charges will be automatically added to a Pay Over Time balance.

benefits.title: No Preset Spending Limit
benefits.description: The spending limit is flexible. Unlike a traditional card with a set limit, the amount you can spend adapts based on factors such as your purchase, payment, and credit history.

notes: Business charge card (No Preset Spending Limit with Pay Over Time) — corrected type from credit to charge. $95 annual fee (an earlier note confusing it with the $150 personal Amex Green Card was wrong). Earns 2X Membership Rewards points on flights and prepaid hotels at AmexTravel.com and 1X on all other eligible purchases. Welcome offer of 15,000 points after $3,000 spend in the first 3 months. 2.7% foreign transaction fee. Fee, APR, and welcome offer confirmed via the official product page and Frequent Miler (values not exposed in the page's static HTML).
